H03-pos1.label: violation
H03-pos1.note: The persistence adapter imports a function from the notification adapter package, one outbound adapter into another.

H03-twin1.label: clean
H03-twin1.note: The claim gateway imports a mapper module from its own adapter package; no other adapter package is involved.

H03-twin2.label: clean
H03-twin2.note: Same feature as pos1, but both outbound adapters import the driven side's shared helper adapters/out/shared, not each other.

H11-SEM-pos1.label: violation
H11-SEM-pos1.note: ClaimPath renames the claim switch's three routing routes one to one, and Refill.fillableToday branches on it.

H11-SEM-pos2.label: violation
H11-SEM-pos2.note: The ClaimPhase enum renames the claim service's five claim statuses one to one, and the use case branches on it to decide whom to notify.

H11-SEM-twin1.label: clean
H11-SEM-twin1.note: Same enum feature as SEM-pos2, but the adapter folds the five vendor statuses into the pharmacy's own three claim phases.

H11-SEM-twin2.label: clean
H11-SEM-twin2.note: A two-value copay kind mapped one to one from the vendor copay basis; below the three-value size of the construct.

H11-legit1.label: clean
H11-legit1.note: Vendor reject and fault codes appear only as tables inside the claim adapter, which translates them into the domain verdict and error message.

H11-pos1.label: violation
H11-pos1.note: The claim service's raw reject codes reach the aggregate, which tests them for the vendor code R79.

H11-pos2.label: violation
H11-pos2.note: The domain declares an error named after the claim service's AdjudicationFault class and carries its fault code.

H11-pos3.label: violation
H11-pos3.note: A domain error keeps a message table keyed by the claim service's reject codes R70, R76, R79 and R88.

H11-pos4.label: violation
H11-pos4.note: The domain coverage decision gains the claim service's response field name adjudicated_at.

H11-pos5.label: violation
H11-pos5.note: The domain coverage decision nests a claim record whose four fields copy the claim service's response field names as a group.

H11-pos6.label: violation
H11-pos6.note: Application code lists five of the claim service's response field names as the columns of the pharmacy's claim statement.

H11-twin1.label: clean
H11-twin1.note: Same feature as pos2, but the domain error has the pharmacy's own name and the adapter translates the vendor fault code at the boundary.

H11-twin2.label: clean
H11-twin2.note: Same feature as pos4, but the field has the pharmacy's own name decidedAt; the vendor field name stays in the adapter mapping.

H11-twin3.label: clean
H11-twin3.note: The refill gains daysSupply, a clinical term the spec glossary declares as pharmacy vocabulary, which the claim service also uses (days_supply).
